annotation.title_clean: White Paper des Österreichischen Rats für Robotik und Künstliche Intelligenz: Die Zukunft Österreichs mit Robotik und Künstlicher Intelligenz positiv gestalten
annotation.title_en: White Paper of the Austrian Council on Robotics and Artificial Intelligence: Shaping Austria's Future with Robotics and AI Positively
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Österreichischer Rat für Robotik und Künstliche Intelligenz (ACRAI), advisory body of BMVIT
annotation.venue: BMVIT / Austrian Council on Robotics and AI (acrai.at)
named_instruments_referenced: EU Civil Law Rules on Robotics 2017
annotation.summary_en: White paper of Austria's advisory Council on Robotics and AI (set up by BMVIT) setting out ethical principles and four action fields for a national robotics and AI strategy: technology/R&D/economy, work and qualification, society and law, and awareness-raising. It combines innovation promotion with safety, ethics, certification and sandboxes.
key_provisions_or_claims: Recommends an incremental, stakeholder-inclusive national robotics and AI strategy aligned with EU initiatives.
Calls for targeted public investment, skills training and requalification of workers.
Recommends sandboxes and testbeds for high-risk, sensitive use cases.
Holds that machines cannot bear moral responsibility; humans retain responsibility, and a clear legal framework for liability is needed.
Recommends reviewing the ethical and legal framework and developing certification, auditing and compliance tools.
